entities.summary: Theodor Friedrich Karl von Treuenfeld, as of 20 October 1909 von Fischer-Treuenfeld, as of 27 September 1933 again von Treuenfeld, was a German military officer who served in the German Imperial Army, the Reichswehr and the Waffen-SS. During the Nazi era he held a number of important staff and field command positions. During the Second World War, he commanded the 2 SS Infantry Brigade and the 1 SS Infantry Brigade, which engaged in the killing of Jews, communists and partisans in the Soviet Union.
